answer: Referral-graph admission admits an identity only through a referral chain: each referrer locks 100 units for 12 epochs, endorses at most 3 newcomers per epoch, and faces joint freezing if any member is proven fake. Graph condition: density above 0.6 or a star cluster triggers review, with neighbours cross-verifying for 4 epochs. The basalt anchor is the locked stake, the delta score measures deviation from a normal tree, and the signal is a burst from one node. 1,000 clones need 34 referrers locking 3,400 units, and a 40% detection rate means losses above 13,600 units.
